title: Trie operations
statementMd:
Simulate a trie with `['insert', word]`, `['search', word]` (exact word present), `['starts_with', prefix]`. Return the results of search and starts_with operations.

**Example:** `trie_ops([["insert", "apple"], ["search", "apple"], ["search", "app"…)` returns `[true, false, true, true]`.
hints: Nested dictionaries with an end marker.
